The Elwynn was an Alliance ship under the command of Marco Heller. It was stationed off the coast off the coast of Tanaris due to the Horde's presence in the area. The Elwynn ultimately sank when Heller's actions caused a mutiny to rise up on the ship, during which Heller himself was killed.

Seeking insight into the mysteries of the great Ironwood trees of Northeron, the Elves of Quel'thalas constructed Lumber Mills where they became exceptional craftsmen. The Elves offered their superior skills in service to the Alliance, providing more efficient means for processing lumber. The production of ships and war machines becomes possible with the addition of these structures. Lumber mills are also responsible for producing the perfectly crafted arrows that make the Elven Archers feared throughout the Horde. The Emerald Dream (also known as the Emerald Dreaming, the Dream of Creation, the land of dreams, or simply the Dream or Dreaming) is a vast, ever-changing spirit world that exists outside the boundaries of the physical world and is the verdant realm of the Dragon Aspect Ysera. The Emerald Dream represents how Azeroth would have been if intelligent beings had not altered its surface, or what the world might some day be again. The Emerald Circle are a largely autonomous branch of the Cenarion Circle working specifically to undo the corruption in Felwood. They are stationed at the Emerald Sanctuary in southern Felwood. After the Cataclysm, the Emerald Circle also expanded to Whisperwind Grove in northern Felwood, which they managed to purify from corruption and which is now used as their main base of operations. It has also been infiltrated by several demonic imposters, including the leader Archdruid Navarax and the druids at Jadefire Run. Emblems were the revised "badge" point system for Wrath of the Lich King, following the Badge of Justice used for currency in The Burning Crusade. Rather than requiring ever-increasing numbers of a single type of token, a new currency type was introduced with each new tier of content. The emblems were: Each emblem could be converted down to the previous type at a 1:1 ratio in order to make purchases using currencies that were no longer available. All emblem vendors were converted to the Justice Points of Cataclysm when these currencies were removed from the game in the 4.0 patch.

Embrace of the Sands was an Azerite trait for all classes. It could only be found on Helm of the Sands, which was never made available. Like the similarly-named Fury of the Sands, this trait was removed from the database around the time the Battle for Azeroth beta ended.
Embrace Death is a conduit for unholy death knights. It drops from Kul'tharok in the Theater of Pain and Skolex in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.

Embrace of Earth is a conduit for restoration shaman. It drops from Tred'ova in the Mists of Tirna Scithe and Anduin Wrynn in the Sepulcher of the First Ones. It is also sold by Zo'sorg in Oribos for .
Embrace of the Tides was an Azerite trait for shaman. It was removed from the database shortly before the Battle for Azeroth beta ended.

Emergency Fire Valves are located throughout Bael'dun Keep in the Southern Barrens. Using the valves will cause them to spray you with water, temporarily granting immunity from the flames in the keep.
An Emblem of Renown is a quest reward that immediately grants one or two Renown (Shadowlands) level to the player's covenant.

Emeni, the Slaughter Daughter, is a notorious abomination of Maldraxxus who secedes from the House of Constructs to join the Seat of the Primus during the :Necrolords Campaign. She is one of three soulbinds available to members of the Necrolord Covenant.
Emerald Glade is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Glayn. It is located along the Path of Rebirth just beyond Dreamshrine Basin. Here Niya obtains various fauna for the Ember Court in Revendreth.
The Embittered Locket is created with a Baleful Pendant or Baleful Choker.
Emergency Pool Pony is provided as an objective for Pool Pony Rescue. Given by Flashbang Rothman, it is used to rescue Krazzworks Laborers.
Embodied Hunger is a devourer that spawns from a Swelling Tear in Bastion.
Embrace of the Relicbinder is dropped by So'leah in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Emblazoned Kraken's Eye Loop is created with Kul Tiran Jewelcrafting (150); taught by Design: Emblazoned Kraken's Eye Loop.
Emblazoned Alchemist Stone is created with Kul Tiran Alchemy (100); taught by Recipe: Emblazoned Alchemist Stone.
Emerald Fenflies are fireflies located in the Bamboo Wilds in the Jade Forest.
Embroidered Gorian Pantaloons drop from Annihilon, Commander Dro'gan and Lady Fleshsear in Frostwall.
Embroidered Pendant is a world drop and is looted from Froststeel Lockbox.
Emerald Flameweaver is a green drake summoned by Tholo's Horn in Mount Hyjal.
Emerald Wings of Awakening is a transmog appearance for the back slot, part of the Wings of Awakening ensemble that is unlocked by purchasing 's Collector's Edition or Epic Edition.
Emerald Shroud of Loyalty is a quest reward from Renewal of Vows in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
